values.note: 'Reservations Required'; book online (Park With Us) or call/text 231-335-7004. No minimum stay, but a one-night booking may be moved to another site before arrival. Full refund less processing fee if cancelled 24+ hours ahead. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon; 1 camper + 1 tent or 2 tents per site.

booking.source: http://muskegonrivercampground.com/ ('* Reservations Required') + rates.html ('No minimum stay required*, no seasonal sites, 21-day maximum stay', refund policy) + contact.html ('Call or Text 231.335.7004'), read 2026-10-22

note: Small campground opened in 2022 at 6190 W 112th St, Grant, between the road and the Muskegon River; no seasonal sites, large pavilion. The river is ~300 m south and the nearest put-in is a township launch under a mile away. Google 4.8 over 65 reviews. --Claude
summary: Operator site + its Park With Us engine: $35/night (all RV sites, June 2027 quote), 24 water/30 A sites to 40 ft, showers, new dump station, reservations required, no minimum, 21-night maximum, engine season May 14 - Sep 27. Note trimmed of site, price, booking and RV Life text. Presence (site + phone) and price both pass; under the US$50 gate.
